nrIncident.summary: Disruption between Manchester Airport and Manchester Piccadilly expected until 05:00
nrIncident.routes:
Northern between between Manchester Airport and Liverpool Lime Street / Blackpool North / Windermere / Millom / Barrow-in-Furness, and also between Crewe and Manchester Piccadilly
TransPennine Express between Manchester Airport and Saltburn / Redcar Central
Transport for Wales between Manchester Airport and Holyhead
nrIncident.message:
A fault with the signalling system at Gatley means that fewer trains are able to run on all lines. As a result, trains between Manchester Airport and Manchester Piccadilly may be delayed by up to 30 minutes or revised or cancelled.
Disruption is expected until 05:00.
There are a number of different options available to help you complete your journey. Please check your whole journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner as some of the alternative routes listed below that you can use your ticket on may also be affected by this disruption.
Northern customer advice:
What should I do?
You can travel on the following services at no extra cost:
• Bee Network / Metrolink services between Manchester Airport and East Didsbury / Manchester Stations
• Bee Network bus services on the following routes: 11, 25, 41, 42, 42A , 42B, 42C, 43, 50, 51, 103, 142, 143 192, 368, 378, 370 and 371
Northern train ticket restrictions have been lifted in the affected areas, including Advance and Peak restrictions, during this disruption. Restrictions will be reinstated once the disruption ends.
TransPennine Express customer advice:
Trains that normally run between Manchester Airport and Redcar Central will be revised to run between Manchester Victoria and Redcar Central only.
Trains running between Manchester Airport and Glasgow Central / Edinburgh are not affected and are able to run as normal.
Usual ticket restrictions have been relaxed. If you have a ticket which is usually valid on a specific train from Manchester Piccadilly, you may use it to travel on any TransPennine Express train from Manchester Victoria.
Due to the current disruption, if you need to travel between the main stations in Manchester city centre, there are several alternative options available:
• Bee Network Free Bus – this free service runs every 10 minutes, with stops conveniently located on the station approach at both Manchester Piccadilly and Manchester Victoria
• Metrolink Tram – regular tram services operate between Manchester Victoria and Manchester Piccadilly an Manchester Airport
• It’s an approximate a 20-minute distance between the two stations
If you have a ticket which is valid on a specific train from Manchester Airport, Manchester Victoria or Manchester Piccadilly, you may use it to travel on any TransPennine Express service from these stations towards your destination.
You can use your ticket at no extra cost on the following tram and bus services in both directions:
• Metrolink services between Manchester Piccadilly / Manchester Victoria and Manchester Airport
• Bee Network buses on routes: 11, 25, 41, 42, 42A , 42B, 42C, 43, 50, 51, 103, 142, 143 192, 368, 378, 370, 371
You can also use your ticket at no extra cost on the following services in both directions:
• Alternative TransPennine Express services between Manchester Piccadilly and Manchester Airport
• Northern services between Manchester Oxford Road /Manchester Piccadilly and Manchester Airport
Ticket flexibility:
If your train is cancelled, you will be able to travel on an alternative service operated by any other participating train company, either two hours before or two hours after the original departure time of the cancelled service, in order to reach your destination.
If you decide not to travel or cannot complete your journey due to cancellations, you are entitled to a full refund from your original point of sale.
For further information and guidance please contact your train company or speak to a member of railway staff.
Check before you travel:
You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.
Compensation:
You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.

nrIncident.summary: Reduced service between Aylesbury Vale Parkway and London Marylebone via Amersham today
nrIncident.routes: Between Aylesbury Vale Parkway / Aylesbury and London Marylebone
nrIncident.message:
A fault with the signalling system between Aylesbury Vale Parkway and London Marylebone via Amersham means fewer trains are able to run on all lines. As a result, some trains operating between these stations will be cancelled or revised.
This is expected to be the case until the end of the day.
Check before you travel:
You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.
Compensation:
You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.
